commits.message: fix(payment): the live web gateway grant becomes atomic, and a failed grant no longer answers 200
commits.author: shalombook

panels.title: Fix: Failed payment returning 200 OK
panels.scene: A slimy goblin merchant burns a villager's bag of gold coins and hands him a glowing paper that reads '200 OK'. The villager weeps with confusion while the Knight stares with a flat expression.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: The monster took my gold, gave me nothing, and smiled!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: It was sending a 200 status code on failure. It lied.

panels.title: Refactor: Make web gateway grant atomic
panels.scene: A magical chest splits into two glowing halves. On one side, gold disappears; on the other, half a magic sword appears. The Knight slices the magic spell with his sword, fusing them back into a solid glowing blue cube.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: Look! The spell either completes whole or doesn't start at all!

bubbles.speaker: Other villager
bubbles.text: No more receiving half a horse! Truly a miracle!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: It's called atomic. All or nothing.

panels.title: Fix: Return actual error when grant fails
panels.scene: A gigantic red stone banner falls from the sky landing in front of the castle gate reading '400 BAD REQUEST'. Villagers drop to their knees weeping tears of joy.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: It told us the truth! It admitted it failed!

bubbles.speaker: Other villager
bubbles.text: Such honesty! I shall build a church for this red message!

panels.title: 1 commit. 1 payment system fixed. 0 fake smiles.
panels.scene: The Knight sits on a wooden bench drinking soup. In the background, villagers carry a golden statue of a giant '200' banner being smashed by a hammer while a priest baptizes a baby.

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: Please just buy your bread and go home.
